# Week 3 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-09-23 (corrected)

## Source and freshness

**Not live for projections.** Built from the committed CI fixture `weekly-report-week-3.json` (generated 2026-09-22 14:19 UTC, with FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injuries). The practice layer is live nflreadpy as of 2026-09-23 20:14 UTC.

**Correction:** the first version of this briefing came from a sandbox run whose projections were deflated about 3x. The DynastyProcess player-id crosswalk returns 403 in this sandbox, so snap share came back empty and `blend.py` collapsed every projection: JSN was at 6.1 if he plays against 21.7 here. That run also could not reach ESPN's injury feed. As a result it misread Dart as benched and recommended starting Bowers, who is Out.

## Practice report

Only Atlanta and Green Bay (Thursday's game) have filed a Week 3 report. **No rostered player is on it.** London and Golden are absent, meaning no concern was listed for either. No DNP/Limited/Full bucket applies to anyone on this roster yet.

| Player | Designation | Source | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jaxson Dart | **Out**: knee, sprained MCL, MRI pending (hurt Monday night) | ESPN via CI fixture | 0.026 |
| Brock Bowers | **Out**: knee, meniscus | ESPN via CI fixture | 0.003 |

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays | Tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @DEN (SNF) | **10.66** | 95.7% | 11.14 | in-house |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs HOU | **18.29** | 93.2% | 19.62 | consensus |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs MIN | **11.63** | 93.2% | 12.47 | in-house |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @WAS | **20.75** | 95.5% | 21.73 | consensus |
| WR | Drake London | @GB (Thu) | **6.46** | 95.5% | 6.76 | in-house |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs TEN | **10.16** | 92.6% | 10.97 | consensus |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs TEN | **10.46** | 93.2% | 11.22 | in-house |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs NYJ | **6.46** | 84.2% | 7.67 | in-house |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @BUF | **4.16** | 97.9% | 4.25 | in-house |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @CHI (MNF) | **4.73** | 100% | 4.73 | in-house |

**Lineup total (expected): 103.76**

**Sit:** Dart (Out), Bowers (Out), Golden (4.94), Downs (5.88), Higgins (5.50).

## Changes since Monday

- **Start Stafford, bench Dart.** Dart hurt his knee Monday night and is Out. This is forced, not a judgement call.
- **Likely stays at TE.** Bowers is Out, so there is no decision here. (The first version of this briefing got this wrong.)
- **WR/FLEX: London and Williams in, Golden out.** London and Williams are tied at 6.46, with Golden at 4.94. It's a thin margin.

## Still uncertain

- **Dart's MRI** decides whether the QB hole lasts one week or several. If it's several, a waiver QB may be worth a bench spot.
- **Bowers** is Out with 0 games played this season. If Sleeper's IR slot takes Out designations, moving him there frees a bench spot.

## Opponent notes

- With Dart out, Winston starts for NYG vs TEN. Skattebo and Likely still start. Winston's offence has historically been pass-heavy and turnover-prone.
- Golden and London meet Thursday night. Neither is on an injury report.

## Byes ahead

None in Weeks 3–4. The nearest is Dicker in Week 7.
